## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and why the change is needed. Link the
relevant issue, if any. Include redacted screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe public API/schema changes, migrations, upgrade or rollback implications,
new dependencies and configuration changes. Write “None” when not applicable.
Do not include credentials or real submission values.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Identify checks not run and why.
For database/browser checks, confirm that disposable local resources were used.

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have regression coverage, or an explanation is provided.
- [ ] Existing schemas, answers, workspace permissions and public contracts remain compatible, or implications are documented.
- [ ] Applied migrations, snapshots and checks were not changed merely to make tests pass.
